description.en-US:
Cookie Switch lets you store, manage, and instantly swap cookie sets for any website. It's built for people who juggle multiple logins — work/personal accounts, team or client accounts, staging vs production — without repeatedly signing in and out.

• Multiple sites & accounts — organise cookie profiles per site, each with a name and notes
• One-click switching — clears the site's current cookies, applies the saved set, and reloads matching tabs
• Accurate capture — “Get Current Account” reads the live cookies exactly as the browser holds them
• Auto update (optional) — keep a saved account in sync when a site rotates its cookies/tokens
• Import, export & full backup — share one account, one site, or back up everything to a JSON file on your device

Your data stays on your device: Cookie Switch has no analytics or tracking, and never sends your cookies anywhere. Exports happen only when you click Export, to a file you control.

summary.en-US: Switch between multiple accounts on any website by swapping saved cookie sets — no repeated sign-in/sign-out.

version.approval_notes: No special account or server is provided by the developer and none is needed. To test: (1) install the extension, (2) open any website and sign in normally with your own/test account, (3) open Cookie Switch, save the site URL, enter an account name, click 'Get Current Account', then 'Save Account', (4) sign out of the website (or sign into a different account and save it as a second account), (5) click 'Switch' next to the first saved account — the site's tabs reload signed in as the first account. All data is stored locally in browser storage; the extension's only network request is an optional version check against its public GitHub repository, and it executes no remote code.
